case_number: 2025 INSC 363; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3243 OF 2025 [arising out of SLP (C) No. 28399/2024]

parties.petitioner: Garden Reach Shipbuilders And Engineers Limited

summary: Compassionate appointment refusal appeal; jurisdictional issue: Division Bench lack authority to hear writ without Chief Justice's roster determination; Rule 26 violation; 'consent does not confer jurisdiction'; writ petition void ab initio; merits not examined; case remanded to High Court with direction for fresh hearing within six months; appointments restrained pending disposal.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 225 of the Constitution of India
Article 226 of the Constitution of India
Rule 26 of High Court Writ Rules
State Bank of India v. Sheo Shankar Tewari
N.C. Santhosh v. State of Karnataka
Shah Babulal Khimji v. Jayaben D. Kania
Sohan Lal Baid v. State of West Bengal
State of Rajasthan v. Prakash Chand
Campaign for Judicial Accountability and Reforms v. Union of India
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court order set aside; writ petition revived for fresh hearing before appropriate bench; appointment freeze maintained pending disposal.
